Dear {{ $json.body.applicant_name }},

Application Successfully Received!

Thank you for applying to the TechHRM Work-Study Program at Filamer Christian University.

We are pleased to confirm that your application and submitted documents have been successfully received. Your application will now proceed to the appropriate evaluation process.

Current Application Status

Thank you, and we wish you the best in your application!

Sincerely,
